limitations.note: The rewrite removed the faulty green-timer reload but also replaced the registered lamp pipeline, lighting red immediately on reset instead of preserving the all-off reset and delayed red startup.
The test asserted the rewrite’s immediate-red reset behavior, so it passed without detecting the cycle-by-cycle mismatch with the original startup sequence.
